description: Inventory and service items (products, services and tracked inventory) for the connected Xero organisation. Read is a single UNPAGINATED GET Items — the generated getItems parameter set is exactly xero_tenant_id, if_modified_since, where, order and unitdp, Items appears in no pageSize rollout, and the generated Items wrapper model carries only the record array (no sibling pagination object, unlike Invoices/Contacts) — so no paginator is declared. Incremental sync is driven by the If-Modified-Since REQUEST HEADER on the UpdatedDateUTC cursor. Write covers both modes: PUT Items creates, POST Items creates-or-updates matched on ItemID. UnitPrice is not a top-level column on this resource — it lives inside the opaque PurchaseDetails/SalesDetails objects, which is what the unitdp query param governs.

If-Modified-Since.description: Xero returns only records created or modified at/after this timestamp. Wire format: 2020-02-06T12:17:43.202-08:00. Owned by replication (cursor UpdatedDateUTC).

unitdp.description: Unit decimal places. unitdp=4 opts in to four-decimal unit amounts; without it Xero rounds them to 2dp. On Items the affected UnitPrice lives inside the opaque PurchaseDetails/SalesDetails payloads, so this changes no typed top-level column — it preserves precision inside the Json columns.

schema.title: Xero GET Items response
schema.description: Xero wraps records in the standard response envelope alongside Id/Status/ProviderName/DateTimeUTC metadata; the Items array carries the records. No sibling pagination object is returned on this resource.

Id.description: Envelope: request correlation id assigned by Xero.

ProviderName.description: Envelope: the name of the calling Xero app.

DateTimeUTC.description: Envelope: response timestamp in Xero MS-JSON form, e.g. /Date(1550797359081)/.

ItemID.description: Xero identifier for the item; the resource primary key and the upsert conflict key.

Code.description: User-defined item code, max 30 characters. The only property Xero marks Required on this resource.

PurchaseDetails.description: Purchase-side defaults (UnitPrice, account and tax codes); surfaced opaque. UnitPrice lives inside and is not separately typed — its wire precision is governed by the unitdp query param.

SalesDetails.description: Sales-side defaults (UnitPrice, account and tax codes); surfaced opaque. UnitPrice lives inside and is not separately typed — its wire precision is governed by the unitdp query param.

IsTrackedAsInventory.description: True when the item is a tracked inventory item.

InventoryAssetAccountCode.description: Account code the inventory asset is posted to; set on tracked inventory items.

TotalCostPool.description: Value of the item on hand, calculated using average cost accounting — a currency-denominated amount, so it is money. Maintained by Xero.

QuantityOnHand.description: Quantity of the item on hand. A count, NOT money — it stays Float64 rather than being forced to 4dp. Maintained by Xero.

UpdatedDateUTC.description: Last-modified timestamp in Xero MS-JSON form with an explicit offset, e.g. /Date(1550797359120+0000)/. Zone-aware per that sample. The replication cursor.

IsSold.description: Whether the item is available for sale.

IsPurchased.description: Whether the item is available for purchase.

StatusAttributeString.description: Validation status attribute returned on write responses (ERROR / WARNING).

unitdp.description: Unit decimal places. unitdp=4 lets Xero accept and return four-decimal UnitPrice values inside the posted PurchaseDetails/SalesDetails instead of rounding them to 2dp.

schema.title: Xero item (create)
schema.description: One Item object, wrapped by the endpoint in Xero's Items array envelope. Server-maintained fields (ItemID, TotalCostPool, QuantityOnHand, UpdatedDateUTC, StatusAttributeString) are deliberately not part of the create contract.

Code.description: User-defined item code, max 30 characters. The only property Xero marks Required.

PurchaseDetails.description: Purchase-side defaults (UnitPrice, account and tax codes); passed through opaque.

SalesDetails.description: Sales-side defaults (UnitPrice, account and tax codes); passed through opaque.

IsTrackedAsInventory.description: True when the item is a tracked inventory item.

InventoryAssetAccountCode.description: Account code the inventory asset is posted to; required by Xero for tracked inventory items.

IsSold.description: Whether the item is available for sale.

IsPurchased.description: Whether the item is available for purchase.

unitdp.description: Unit decimal places. unitdp=4 lets Xero accept and return four-decimal UnitPrice values inside the posted PurchaseDetails/SalesDetails instead of rounding them to 2dp.

schema.title: Xero item (create or update)
schema.description: One Item object, wrapped by the endpoint in Xero's Items array envelope. ItemID is the match key; Xero creates a new item when it does not resolve to an existing one. Server-maintained fields (TotalCostPool, QuantityOnHand, UpdatedDateUTC, StatusAttributeString) are not part of the write contract.

ItemID.description: Xero identifier of the item to match; the upsert conflict key. Xero creates a new item when it does not resolve to an existing one.

Code.description: User-defined item code, max 30 characters. The only property Xero marks Required.

PurchaseDetails.description: Purchase-side defaults (UnitPrice, account and tax codes); passed through opaque.

SalesDetails.description: Sales-side defaults (UnitPrice, account and tax codes); passed through opaque.

IsTrackedAsInventory.description: True when the item is a tracked inventory item.

InventoryAssetAccountCode.description: Account code the inventory asset is posted to; required by Xero for tracked inventory items.

IsSold.description: Whether the item is available for sale.

IsPurchased.description: Whether the item is available for purchase.
